title: Solo fiddle playing part of a hornpipe
author: TheFlyFishingFilmmaker
description: > This high-quality sound effect captures the sound of a fiddle playing the resolving end to a hornpipe with precision and nuance. A hornpipe is a type of dance tune that is typically played at a fast tempo and has a distinctive rhythm. The sound of the fiddle is authentic and raw, making it perfect for sound designers, filmmakers, and content creators. The resolving end of the hornpipe adds a sense of resolution and finality to any project, making it perfect for adding the finishing touch to a wide variety of projects.

title: Don Richardson - Mississippi Sawyer

Fiddler Don Richardson plays traditional tune "Mississippi Sawyer" in what may be the first country music recording session in April of 1916. The tune dates from the 1830s, as far as I can determine. 

From the original 78rpm disk.
